about: Orillia sits at the Narrows between Lake Couchiching and Lake Simcoe in central Ontario, where the Trent–Severn Waterway passes through town. It is a waterfront service city for the northern Simcoe lakes, with a restored opera house, a Stephen Leacock museum on the shore, and Highway 11 on the inland side. About 33,000 people live in Orillia.
